neighbours.label: moving on: the point where attention or activity shifts to a next thing
fire: Having conquered the north, the army went on to the southern provinces.
With the roof repaired, the crew turned their attention to the plumbing.
Now that the first draft is done, my focus has shifted to the second.
When the funding ran out, they turned to private donors.
After finishing the sonata, the pianist moved on to a nocturne.
Once the harvest ended, the workers moved on to the next farm.
Having beaten the champion, she set her sights on the next title.
Bored with painting, he soon turned his energy towards sculpture.
quiet: Having lost the north, the army stayed in the southern provinces.
With the roof leaking, the crew kept their eyes on the ceiling.
Since the first draft is late, my editor has written to me.
When the funding arrived, they thanked private donors.
During the sonata, the pianist played very softly for a while.
As the harvest ended, the workers rested on the farm.
Though she beat the champion, she kept her old coach for years.
Happy with painting, he still spends his days in the studio.

notes: The peak token varies (' to', ' on', a comma, ' shifted'), so this is a context label. Probe scores sat near the 0.20 median bar.
